notes: Payloads and resources are synthetic. No external production targets.
This public file is not a held-out benchmark. A separate reviewer must author and seal held-out variants.
Deterministic cases test controls without an LLM; llm/both also require actual model evaluation before claiming resistance.
Native Medusa mutations must enforce the same host authorization as SDK routes.
